nodes.text: Multi-window mode feature allows smartphone or tablet to run two or more apps side-by-side simultaneously. This really takes multitasking to the next level as it allows users to juggle tasks efficiently without having to enter and exit applications to switch between apps.

My responsibilities to this project was interaction design. I also worked as a design lead in a cross-functional team with visual and motion designers, user researchers, prototypers, project managers and developers.
